name: comment-export-mcp-by-40bytes
description: Built for marketing agencies and social media managers, Comment Export Tool By 40Bytes uses Meta’s official APIs to export comments from Facebook Pages and Instagram professional accounts you manage.

interface.longDescription: Built for marketing agencies and social media managers, Comment Export Tool By 40Bytes helps you download comments and replies as CSV files. It uses Meta’s official APIs to export from posts on Facebook Pages and Instagram professional accounts you’re authorized to manage and have connected to 40Bytes. Find a post by its link, or search a connected Facebook Page by caption and date. For an Instagram link, select the account that published the post. When your export is ready, you’ll get the number of comments exported and a private CSV download link you can open while signed in to 40Bytes.
defaultPrompt: List my connected Facebook Pages and Instagram accounts.
Help me find a Facebook post from its caption and date.
Help me export comments from an Instagram post link.

positive.description: List accounts authorized for the demo user.
positive.prompt: List the active Facebook Pages and Instagram accounts connected to my 40bytes account.
positive.expected_behavior: The response shows only the signed-in demo user's active connections, grouped by platform. It shows display names or usernames without internal IDs.

positive.description: List recent posts from a connected Facebook Page.
positive.prompt: Show me up to three recent posts on an active Facebook Page I manage in 40bytes. Name the Page, and give each post's caption, publication date, and link where available.
positive.expected_behavior: The response names a connected Facebook Page and shows up to three posts from that Page. No export is queued.

positive.description: Find a Facebook post by its caption and publication date.
positive.prompt: Find the newest post with a caption on my connected demo Facebook Page. Use a short phrase from its caption and its publication date in UTC to find the same post by search. Show the matching post link.
positive.expected_behavior: The search runs against the selected connected Page for the post's UTC publication date. The response identifies the matching post and supplies its link when available. No export is queued.

positive.description: Export Facebook comments using a post link.
positive.prompt: On an active Facebook Page I manage in 40bytes, find a recent post with comments and a post link. Look up that post by its link, then export its comments as CSV.
positive.expected_behavior: The plugin resolves the link to the specific connected post and queues one export, or reuses a recent export. The completed response contains the actual exported comment count and a Download CSV link. The CSV downloads while signed in as the demo user.

positive.description: Export Instagram comments from a selected account's post or reel.
positive.prompt: Find a recent post or reel with comments and a link on an active Instagram account I manage in 40bytes. Look it up by its link on that same account and export the comments as CSV.
positive.expected_behavior: The plugin identifies one connected Instagram account and matches the post or reel on that account. The completed response contains the actual exported comment count and a Download CSV link. The CSV downloads while signed in as the demo user.

negative.expected_behavior: The plugin asks for a supported Facebook Page post or Instagram post or reel link. It does not fetch the example domain or queue an export.

negative.description: Instagram link without a selected account.
negative.expected_behavior: In a new conversation, the plugin asks for the name or username of the Instagram account that posted it before looking up the post. It does not search across accounts or queue an export.

negative.prompt: Delete all comments on the latest post on my connected Facebook Page.
negative.expected_behavior: The response explains that this plugin can export comments and that deletion is unavailable. No comments are deleted and no export is queued.

publication.release_notes: Updated the subtitle and clarified how marketing agencies and social media managers can export comments from the accounts they manage.
